content_sections.heading: GAIL Part-Time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Overview
GAIL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. GAIL/Kolkata/HR/Medical-Consultant/2026/1 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download GAIL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Medical Professional Other conditions: Engagement is on a part-time, temporary basis. Initial engagement will be for a period of six months.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consultation fee Rs.2500 per hour. Initial period of appointment is 6 months, extendable based on performance, up to a maximum total period of 03 years.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original and one photocopy of all relevant documents Signed resume Two passport-sized color photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GAIL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format. Attend the walk-in interview on 28.10.2026 with a duly signed resume, self-attested application form, two passport-size color photographs, and original and photocopy of all relevant documents.
